skills.name: Blades
skills.description: Strike with swords, axes, and other edged melee weapons.

skills.name: Blunt
skills.description: Strike with maces, hammers, staves, and other bludgeoning melee weapons.

skills.name: Piercing
skills.description: Thrust and stab with spears, rapiers, daggers, and other piercing melee weapons.

skills.name: Unarmed
skills.description: Fight with fists, claws, and brawling techniques.

skills.name: Marksmanship
skills.description: Attack with bows, crossbows, slings, and thrown weapons.

skills.name: Block
skills.description: Absorb and deflect blows with shields and armor.

skills.name: Red Magic
skills.description: Offensive magic: fire, frost, shock, poison, and drains.

skills.name: Orange Magic
skills.description: Summoning, bound weapons, and energy creation.

skills.name: Yellow Magic
skills.description: Light, invisibility, charm, and calm.

skills.name: Green Magic
skills.description: Mortal restoration: healing, buffs, and cures.

skills.name: Blue Magic
skills.description: Alteration of the physical: feather, water-walking, locks, transmutation.

skills.name: Indigo Magic
skills.description: Force manipulation and levitation.

skills.name: Violet Magic
skills.description: Soul detection and storage, telekinesis, mark/recall, dispel.

skills.name: White Magic
skills.description: Holy and divine power: protection auras, banish undead and demons, divine-grade healing, sanctify. Opposed by Black.

skills.name: Black Magic
skills.description: Necromancy and death: raise undead, life-drain, decay, curses, soul-corruption. Opposed by White.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Move silently and stay unseen.

skills.name: Lockpick
skills.description: Open locks and disarm simple mechanisms.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: Pick pockets and conceal objects.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Influence others through charm, logic, and barter.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: Lie convincingly and conceal your intent.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: Coerce others through threats and force of presence.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Recall knowledge of magic, history, religion, nature, and the wider world.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: Find clues, deduce conclusions, and search for hidden things.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Read motives, emotions, and intentions.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Track, forage, navigate, and endure the wilds.

skills.name: Animal Handling
skills.description: Calm, train, and command beasts.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Treat wounds, stabilize the dying, and diagnose illness without magic.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Climb, swim, jump, and grapple.

skills.name: Repair
skills.description: Mend, maintain, and improvise gear (see the crafting module).

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.description: Brew potions and poisons from reagents (see the alchemy module).

skills.name: Blacksmithing
skills.description: Forge and shape metal weapons, armor, and tools at the anvil (see the crafting module).

skills.name: Crafting
skills.description: Create tools, equipment, and other items from raw materials (see the crafting module).

skills.name: Enchanting
skills.description: Craft magical trinkets and permanently enchant items with magical effects (see the magic-crafting module).

skills.name: Engineering
skills.description: Design and construct complex mechanisms, devices, and siege engines.

skills.name: Building
skills.description: Construct buildings, fortifications, bridges, and other large-scale structures.

skills.name: Farming
skills.description: Cultivate crops, tend livestock, and produce food and other agricultural goods.
